summary: Project is a "Payment Tracker" app; user requests generating/exporting full project program files and folder structure, and wants to publish to production under the new name.

existing_features.title: Update all user-facing app naming to consistently use the production name "Payment Tracker App" across the frontend (document title/metadata, login screen branding text and alt text, and in-app header/brand label) and any other visible strings where the old name appears (e.g., "Monthly Payment Tracker", "Payment Tracker", "Finance Tracker").

Add a repo-local export package that contains the full project folder structure snapshot for delivery: create a top-level folder (e.g., "delivery/") with (a) a human-readable tree/index of the project structure and (b) a reproducible script/command documented in that folder that (re)generates the snapshot from the repo sources without manual copying.

Stabilize and complete the end-to-end publish flow to production on the Internet Computer by identifying and fixing deterministic causes of the intermittent build/deploy failure so consecutive deployments can complete reliably (frontend build, canister build, deploy).

new_feature_requests.summary: Publish the deployed app to production under the name "Payment Tracker App" (requires rename command).
Generate and provide the full project folder structure (complete app program files).
Collect problem files into a separate folder for delivery.

Collect "problem files" relevant to diagnosing build/deploy failures into a dedicated subfolder inside the delivery package, and include a short README describing what each collected file is used for and why it is included.
